column1: # Friendly names for server settings. Pipe-separated; edit freely, then run: python catalog/build_catalog.py
# file        = path under config/ exactly as on disk
# key         = the real setting name in the file (never change this column)
# name        = what the config manager shows
# unit        = optional unit shown beside the value (×, %, seconds, ms, minutes, hours, days, adena, ...)
# description = optional; replaces the file's own comment when the comment is unhelpful
server-game|Rates.ini|RateXp|Experience (XP) rate|times|How fast characters gain experience from monsters. 1 = retail.
server-game|Rates.ini|RateSp|Skill point (SP) rate|times|How fast characters gain skill points from monsters. 1 = retail.

server-game|Rates.ini|RatePartyXp|Extra experience for being in a party|times|Multiplies only the size bonus a party gets, not the experience itself. The experience rate does that. At 1 a party still earns the normal party bonus.
server-game|Rates.ini|RatePartySp|Extra skill points for being in a party|times|Multiplies only the size bonus a party gets, not the skill points themselves. The skill point rate does that.
server-game|Rates.ini|RateKarmaLost|Karma lost per death or kill|times|
server-game|Rates.ini|RateExtractable|Rewards from opening boxes and extractable items|times|
server-game|Rates.ini|RateTeleportFee|Gatekeeper teleport price|times|Scales the adena price of normal town gatekeeper teleports. 1 = retail prices, 0.5 = half price.
server-game|Rates.ini|UseQuestRewardMultipliers|Use separate quest reward multipliers per item type||
server-game|Rates.ini|MonsterExpMaxLevelDifference|No experience from monsters more than this many levels below you|levels|

server-game|Rates.ini|DeathDropAmountMultiplier|Drop amount (how much per drop)|times|Multiplies the size of each drop. This keeps working however high you set it, so it is the safe way to raise rates.

server-game|Rates.ini|DeathDropChanceMultiplier|Drop chance (how often something drops)|times|Multiplies how often a drop happens. Each drop is rolled once, so anything above a 100% chance is wasted: past that point only the drop amount still helps. The Rates tab works this out for you.

server-game|Rates.ini|DropAmountMultiplierByItemId|Drop amount for specific items (adena is item 57)||Format: itemId,multiplier;itemId,multiplier. Items listed here use this instead of the general drop amount, not as well as it.

server-game|Rates.ini|DropChanceMultiplierByItemId|Drop chance for specific items (adena is item 57)||Format: itemId,multiplier;itemId,multiplier. Items listed here use this instead of the general drop chance, not as well as it.

server-game|Rates.ini|DropMaxOccurrencesNormal|Most different items a normal monster can drop at once||A kill stops here however high the rates go, so raising the drop amount gives bigger piles rather than more kinds of item.
server-game|Rates.ini|DropMaxOccurrencesRaidboss|Most different items a raid boss can drop at once||

server-game|Rates.ini|EventItemMaxLevelDifference|Event items stop dropping beyond this level difference|levels|
